name: Scratches
help:
# scratches

Film scratch overlay

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| density | float | 0.3 | 0-1 | Scratch density |
| alpha | float | 0.75 | 0-1 | Scratch opacity |
| seed | int | 1 | 1-100 | Random seed |
